intro: I turn complex problems into simple digital experiences. From the first pixel to products used by thousands of people.
aboutTitle:
BUILDING INTERFACES.
CONNECTING PEOPLE.
SHIPPING PRODUCTS.
aboutText: I’m Gabriel, a full stack developer specializing in front-end and mobile. For over 6 years, I’ve connected engineering, design and product thinking to turn ideas into fast, accessible and reliable applications.
aboutMore: From iFood’s delivery ecosystem to Emanu, the startup I co-founded, my work extends from interfaces to architecture, testing, API integration and the details that make an experience feel right.
projectNote: Visual compositions represent the types of product, rather than screenshots of the original applications. This work was delivered as part of my roles at the companies shown.
projectCopy: A faith and spiritual growth platform with personalized experiences, subscriptions and AI.

As co-founder and CTO, I built the web platform and mobile app with React, Next.js, React Native and Node.js. I designed and launched the premium subscription journey and integrated AI features to support users in their spiritual growth.
Complex under the hood. Simple on screen.
Device grading with condition-assessment rules and real-time pricing.

I developed the Next.js Grading system for Doji’s trade-in ecosystem. The interface translates complex condition-assessment rules into a clear workflow connected to real-time pricing and the device resale lifecycle.
Reliability in the palm of your hand.
A mobile app running automated functional tests to check device integrity.

I developed a React Native app to run automated functional tests on mobile devices. I connected web and mobile workflows to maintain consistent data and support reverse logistics throughout the trade-in process.
An application for courier assignment, distance calculations and delivery estimates.

At iFood, I built a React and TypeScript application for delivery parameters: courier selection, restaurant-to-customer distance and estimated delivery times. I wrote tests with Jest, React Testing Library and Cypress and built accessible interfaces with SASS and Styled Components.
The journey starts with the experience.
Travel service pages connecting people with insurance, currency exchange and connectivity.

At Hurb, I built Next.js pages presenting travel services and helping users discover complementary products such as insurance, currency exchange and international SIM cards, using TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and SASS.
Tools to manage sales and listings across major marketplaces.

At Lexos, I developed Angular and Vue.js features for a platform managing sales and listings on Mercado Livre, Shopee, AliExpress and Magalu. I integrated APIs and wrote unit tests with Karma and Jasmine.
school: Centro Universitário União das Américas Descomplica
experienceCopy: From MVP to a platform with 150k+ downloads. Web, mobile, subscriptions and AI.
A trade-in ecosystem spanning device grading, pricing and automated diagnostics.
Delivery operations interfaces focused on accessibility, testing and reliability.
Teaching front-end fundamentals, modern tools, testing and accessibility.
Web experiences for discovering travel services and complementary products.
Security service hiring and management applications with API integration and testing.
Sales and listing management integrated with major marketplaces.
Leading the front-end team, introducing agile practices and prototyping UI/UX.
Sales management systems, API integration, prototyping and customer support.
A web application distributing education news to Brazilian schools.
contactText: Great products start with a good conversation. I’m open to front-end, mobile and full stack challenges with teams that care about the experience.
footer: Made with intention. Built with code.
